trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first and this one pops on its own. Everything is single-player, there is no online trophy and no DLC is needed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. A story trophy, it unlocks on its own and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 through to the end. The trophy pops when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 2 through to the end. The trophy pops when the first mission of Chapter 3 begins.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3 through to the end. The trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 through to the end. The trophy pops after its final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. A story trophy, it unlocks on its own and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy, it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy, it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. A story trophy, it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. A story trophy, it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy, it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy, it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work through the checklist. It is far more forgiving than it sounds, closer to 60% true completion: scan any 200 of 277 vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals, finish any 70 of 80 challenges, complete 15 of 18 card sets, find 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 Cocaine Flamingos, and do any 100 optional missions. The only parts that demand everything are the robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), the shooting ranges, the drone races and Bret's quests. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, All 55 Trophies

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four types freely: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to pile them up. Track your progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist later wants 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or drone race) and performing a stunt. Most come up on their own in the story; check Progress, Activities to see which types are still untouched.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges. Get comfortable with the weapon handling first; the medals are demanding but not brutal, and your focus level grows as you practise.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations (42 races in total). You need a win at each spot, not a win in every race.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Any race type counts, so take the ones you are fastest at.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento, marked with a purple icon. Go there, take the fishing challenge and beat him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games. Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once, not beat every challenge, so pick the game you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Lucia's Andy questline in Belville, which opens in Chapter 3 (Lucia only): Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Andy calls first, then texts her address. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line. After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he calls and marks his shop in Key Lento with a green KR icon. He marks purple treasure chests on the map; dive to the shipwrecks, use the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring each set back. He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 and 3; calling Brian as Jason speeds it up. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County, which opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger questlines. Only certain ones count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters are Kirk (the Skunk Ape and Mr. Mangrove hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (plane deliveries). More stranger lines are still being mapped, so use the trophy tracker in the trophy list to watch your count. Everything is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, All 55 Trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. After Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you get the Key Cloner and deliver the Zorrusso to him. He then wants 16 more sports cars; scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on his list, steal it and drive it to his garage in west Vice City. Delivering in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List; sports cars turn up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Jason's Tyrone line (Jason only). After Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy enough labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone hands you Spin On This to shut the labs down for good. All still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice. The one to watch is in Chapter 1 at Jason's house: after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to teach you. It is not marked as a spot and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required, so do it while you can. The last spot only opens once you can play both characters, after Coffee Break. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel's hunting line (Jason only). After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Bret texts you and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He hands you the unique Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle, then marks hunting spots on the map; bring him the animals he asks for. There are 15 Target Decks and the checklist wants all of them, but which exact animal pops this trophy is still unconfirmed, so work the decks in order and watch for it. One clean shot keeps a kill pristine and pays more.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets hidden around Leonida. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this pops early on the way there.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK objects with the phone app (hold Up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Any 100 count, so scan whatever you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way there. Check Progress, Challenges and pick the easiest ones left; plenty are finished naturally while working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside (call them with Right plus Triangle, available after Coffee Break), build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route: cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you and the wanted level flashing red and blue, rob 3 shops back to back without the wanted level dropping. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's jewelry jobs from Chapter 3 are done; loot a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs, and keep going to a fourth shop if it has not popped. The pop is delayed about half a minute after the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan). Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing; you only need to scan them, not drive them. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. The checklist wants 200, so this comes naturally.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming). Buff your focus first with food, drink or Adrenaline, wear body armor and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up a group at a gang operation and take them down fast. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus level grows through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA; the ones parked on the open airfield do not count. The easiest is at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the south-west edge of the map, in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive in through the gate or over the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and fire at enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. Start with Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, grab the cash with your partner (hand off a bag with Right) and escape the 4-star heat on a fast bike. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans. There are 8 large bank jobs; the checklist wants all of them, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults counts: tailing the truck to the bank and emptying its vault qualifies. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it and escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida. A plane is fastest: fly over every blacked-out area until the whole map is visible.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total). They show as yellow icons when you get close; track each gang under Progress, Gangs. The checklist wants all 39, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing by the bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window. You need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS first. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep driving down the street. A nod to the Banshee from GTA III; only this car counts.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation), steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you blow with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and if you miss an item the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum strength at the same time. Work out together (call your partner with Right plus Triangle): while one trains, the other finishes theirs too, doubling progress. Buy a fitness club membership and filter for clubs on Map, Activities. Available after Coffee Break, when you can switch characters.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your criminal profile; the count shows on the trophy itself. Turn on profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Stealthy jobs, clean escapes and destroying evidence push you toward Professional; roughing people up pushes Hardened; killing pushes Violent; mass cop and civilian kills push Psycho, and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going that far. It mostly happens on its own while doing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method still unconfirmed. The working theory is that it ties to the Payday Loans store from the prologue in Little Cuba, Vice City, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way. No verified method exists yet; this guide will not invent one. Check back once the community confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg. At night after 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO's blue light. Approach it, talk to the woman it drops, offer to help and walk her back to her car at the roadside. The car does not always spawn; drive away and return to try again.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach make it easy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check to get the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays best. The total is cumulative, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (12 exist; 4 come from the story). They unlock after Chapter 2's Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone, and cost $160,000 in total. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. It installs after Chapter 2's Moses mission; drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. You need enough garage space first (see Little Boxes), and at first he only takes vehicles without trackers; standard-tracker cars open up in Chapter 3 and at Pay 'n' Sprays. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
